profile.summary: SashaKoro demonstrates a specialized but deep expertise in Axios, focusing on its core HTTP client architecture, interceptor system, and asynchronous request behavior. Their contributions show architectural-level thinking around request predictability and interceptor extensibility, with evidence of CI/CD debugging and an intent to improve testing and documentation. The profile reflects a mid-level developer with strong async/await knowledge and a focus on backend utility libraries rather than frontend frameworks or broader JS ecosystem tools.
